title: docs(qa): approvals cross-org provisioning recipe scores decision-action-matrix A9
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8BZWLVmF49pt7EtrY1njbAP)_
Fixes #26621

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`areas/approvals.json` 新增区级配方 `qa-cross-org-request`,`decision-action-matrix` 的 A9 引用它,revision 9 → 10。
- 为什么改:A9 要的「无组织审批请求」已不可能存在(ADR-0131 后 organization_id 为 NOT NULL),两轮 18.2.0 都只能记 blocked(fixture);配方改用第二组织的请求,同样触发 READ_BACK_FAILED。
- 风险与回滚:只改 QA 台账一个 JSON 文件,不动产品代码;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` 顶部 `fixtures` 块(七步调用),再看 A9 的 `verify` 与 history revision 10。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期 OK,且显示 6 个区级配方、6/6 被引用。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` gains an area-level `fixtures` block with one recipe, `qa-cross-org-request`, in the README's "Area-level `fixtures`" shape: seven REST calls that open a pending `showcase_budget_approval` request inside a second organization and leave the caller narrowed to the Default Organization.
- `approvals.decision-action-matrix` (revision 9 → 10) opts in with `fixtures.provisioning.use` + `why`; `knownGaps[0]` is rewritten as CLOSED-by-recipe (its two lower-layer pins kept); `acceptance[9].verify` and `evidence` name the cross-organization request; `steps` gains the read-back step; `source` cites `approval-service.ts#findRequestRow`; `history` records the re-drive and its verdict. The clause sentence itself is unchanged.

## Why

A9 scored `blocked(fixture)` in both 18.2.0 waves because no stock door mints an organization-less approval request. Measured on main 74db43ef, that state is not a fixture gap but gone: `organization_id` is NOT NULL on `sys_approval_request`, `sys_approval_approver` and `sys_approval_action` (ADR-0131), and an organization-less system insert is stamped with the install's one organization or refused (ADR-0131 D9). The clause's sentence, though, is about any request "invisible inside the caller's organization narrowing", and that shape is reachable: under the `group` posture the platform admin can hold two organizations, and the by-id read-back (`findRequestRow`) narrows to the caller's active one.

The card's hypothesis was measured first and refuted: on a single-posture boot with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`, a scratch-package time-relative sweep (type `schedule`, `runAs: system`, 60 s interval) over a tenancy-disabled scratch object opened its request stamped with the Default Organization, and a `node:sqlite` UPDATE of that column to NULL answers `NOT NULL constraint failed`. No product card is needed: a door exists.

## Tests

No code changed, so no test was added or run beyond the gates below. The recipe and the clause were driven on live boots of `examples/app-showcase` built from 74db43ef:

<details><summary>Re-drive of acceptance[9] on the recipe, literal replay, fresh group-posture boot (REST only)</summary>

Boot: `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38623`

```text
POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email -> 200            A = org_mvqugx58o3yoxgfa
POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create -> 200      B = hGCuSo47VLEbWkmDA6qt2qy61IwaCBV8 members ["owner"]
POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active -> 200
POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account -> 201         account org = B
POST /api/v1/data/showcase_project -> 201
PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_project/fIRdUWyTbllnPk1M -> 200
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=pending -> 200   R = areq_5137765a-… org B step manager_review
POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active -> 200  (back to A)
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/R -> 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND
POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/R/approve -> 500
   {"code":"READ_BACK_FAILED","error":"the write to approval request 'areq_5137765a-…' was recorded, but the updated row is not visible inside the caller's organization scope, so the result envelope cannot be built. The write is NOT rolled back — read the request back with a system or matching-organization context."}
POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active -> 200  (B)
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/R -> 200           status approved, org B, completed_at set
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/R/actions -> 200   [submit, comment (admin_rescue routing note), approve]
```

Verdict for acceptance[9]: pass. The approve action row reads `via_override` false: the admin was on R's slate as B's administrator.

</details>

<details><summary>Refuting legs (single-posture boot, scheduled work on)</summary>

- Time-relative sweep over the tenancy-disabled `approvals_qa_subject`: request `areq_2c748c76-…` opened `pending` with `organization_id = org_mvqu4ffm6g21lfjy` (the Default Organization).
- `UPDATE sys_approval_request SET organization_id = NULL …` (and the same on `sys_approval_approver` / `sys_approval_action`): `NOT NULL constraint failed` on all three.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/create` under `single`: `403 ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Done-when line 1 says "a stock showcase boot". The recipe uses the stock showcase app with no repo change, but boots it with three environment variables (the `group` posture and the two settings that posture refuses to boot without). The card's own hypothesis needed an environment flag too (`OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`); the recipe's `requires` names the boot exactly, and its `knownGaps[1]` says acceptance[9] runs on that boot alone.
- The recipe was measured at 74db43ef; this branch then merged origin/main 0f3d068c. The incoming approvals change (ADR-0142 queue approvers) does not touch `findRequestRow`, `readBackRequest` or `isOverrideActor`.
- Drift left as is (comment and ledger text, not filed): `readBackRequest`'s docblock still calls org-less rows "a live state", `isOverrideActor`'s null-org arm is reached by no row, and the item's `handleApprovalError` source note still says READ_BACK_FAILED is "deliberately unmapped" while its verify says it is a named 500 row.
- The `qa-scratch-authz` recipe's object names (`qa_vault`, …) would now be refused at save: a package-authored object must carry the package namespace prefix (`422 NAMESPACE_PREFIX`, measured while building the scratch package here). Not this card's area.

## Verification

Gates at merge head 47385df4: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 16 commands; all 16 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: OK, 6 area recipes, 11 item references resolved, 6/6 recipes referenced, symbol anchors 995/1005 resolved (10 on the named residual, unchanged from base). No changeset: the diff touches only `docs/qa/**`, which no package publishes (`skip-changeset`).
